description: This file defines the OperationState enum used in Apache Hive's Thrift server to represent and manage the states of operations, including state transitions and validation logic.

classes.name: OperationState
classes.description: Enum representing various states of an operation in Hive, with methods for state transition validation and conversion to TOperationState.

methods.name: getOperationState
methods.description: Returns the OperationState corresponding to a given TOperationState.

methods.name: validateTransition
methods.description: Validates if transitioning from oldState to newState is allowed; throws HiveSQLException if invalid.

methods.name: validateTransition (instance method)
methods.description: Validates if transitioning from current state to newState is allowed.

methods.name: toTOperationState
methods.description: Converts OperationState to its corresponding TOperationState.

methods.name: isTerminal
methods.description: Checks if the current state is a terminal state.
